title: Shakira Sets Amazon Music Livestream Record With Madrid Show and Dua Lipa Duet
excerpt: Shakira's October 3 Madrid concert set a new Amazon Music livestream record for a female artist, with Dua Lipa joining her onstage for "Antología."
body:
Shakira's October 3 Madrid concert set a new Amazon Music livestream record for a female artist, with Dua Lipa joining her onstage for "Antología." Amazon announced the milestone the following day but did not release a viewer total.

The concert streamed worldwide through Amazon Music, Prime Video and Twitch, making it Shakira's first full-concert global livestream. No paid subscription was required. Amazon's claim applies specifically to performances livestreamed on its own platform rather than to concert streams across every service. The broadcast was also the centerpiece of the 2026 edition of Amazon Music's Women Shaping Latin Music campaign.

Dua Lipa joined Shakira for "Antología," the ballad from *Pies Descalzos*, released in 1995. It was the first time the two artists had performed together. The song already had a history between them. During her 2025 stop in Bogotá, Dua Lipa covered "Antología" as part of the local-song tradition she used throughout the *Radical Optimism Tour*. Shakira responded online, saying she was moved to hear the song in Dua Lipa's voice in the same city where she had written it years earlier. Madrid turned that exchange into an actual duet.

[ig:p:DeFRhLolil0|@shakira|https://www.instagram.com/p/DeFRhLolil0/]

The livestream came from Shakira Stadium, a temporary venue integrated into Madrid's Iberdrola Music complex for the residency. It holds more than 50,000 people and was created specifically for this run of shows. Live Nation has framed the project as Spain's first use of the large-scale international artist residency format, giving Shakira a custom setting rather than moving the production between existing arenas.

The concerts are only one part of the Madrid project. Under the Es Latina banner, the site also hosts exhibitions, talks, workshops, film, food and literature programming built around Latin culture. Amazon Music added its own spaces, including an interactive Shakira museum tracing her career across music, fashion and cultural impact, as well as an all-women stage reworking songs from her catalog.

That broader setting helps explain why Amazon chose Madrid for Shakira's first complete concert broadcast to a global audience. The residency arrives near the end of the *Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour*, which began in February 2025 and has since become the highest-grossing tour by a Latin artist. The October 3 stream gave viewers outside Spain access to one night of that final European chapter, while the Amazon Music record added another milestone to a tour already built around unusually large-scale shows.
